one_line_contribution: That the harm from injected agent memory is caused by commitment *order* rather than volume or content — demonstrated by a token-matched intervention (log a memory-free draft, then revise against the identical retrieved items) — plus the risky corollary that GEPA-optimized instructions make memory-first injection more harmful, not less.
closest_prior_work: The collision check covers the 2026 agent-memory cluster well but is blind to the knowledge-conflict RAG literature, where the exact manipulation already exists. Xie et al., 'Adaptive Chameleon or Stubborn Sloth: Revealing the Behavior of LLMs in Knowledge Conflicts' (ICLR 2024) explicitly compares presenting conflicting external evidence cold versus after eliciting the model's own parametric answer, and reports a confirmation-bias/anchoring effect — i.e. that a prior commitment changes whether the model abandons its own answer. That is A1 vs. A2 in a non-agentic setting. Longpre et al. 2021 (entity-substitution conflict) and the generate-then-read line (GenRead, COMBO, Astute RAG 2504.13079) round out the same idea. Astute RAG is conceded and implemented as A5, which is good; Xie et al. is not cited at all, and it is the work that makes 'a logged pre-retrieval commitment reduces override' a confirmation rather than a discovery. What survives as new is narrower than the abstract claims: the agent-loop instantiation, the token-matched fix/break decomposition, and the P4 interaction with prompt optimization.
strongest_objection: P4, the proposal's self-declared sharpest and only unclaimed contribution, is confounded by construction. 'Break' is defined as right→wrong relative to a matched no-memory reference (A0 for the base arm, G0 for the coupling arm), but the plan reports break counts/rates over all 600 instances rather than over the at-risk set (instances the matched reference got right). If I* raises no-memory accuracy at all — which G0 exists to show it does — then G0 has a strictly larger pool of correct answers available to be broken, so the break count rises mechanically with zero change in the agent's propensity to override. The difference-in-differences (G1−G0) vs. (A1−A0) therefore mixes a real anchoring interaction with an at-risk-base-rate artifact, and the mixed-effects logistic model with a memory×optimization product term inherits the same problem unless it is fit on the at-risk subset. The prediction is stated as a ≥1.5× ratio and ≥3 absolute points precisely in the range that a 10-point accuracy gain from I* could partly manufacture. Secondarily: the same denominator issue means a *positive* P4 result cannot distinguish 'optimization amplifies anchoring' from 'optimization gives memory more to break,' which is the anti-synergy claim's entire content.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Redefine every break endpoint as a rate conditional on the matched no-memory reference being correct, and re-derive the P1 and P4 power analyses on that at-risk denominator; report raw counts beside it. (2) Run at least three independent GEPA searches for I* with different seeds and treat run as a random effect — the proposal admits I* is a single draw, and a one-draw interaction claim will not survive review whatever its sign. (3) Add the co-optimized arm (GEPA run *with* memory-first injection in the loop), which is the composition the track actually asks about; the current I* is optimized memory-free, so P4 tests a strawman deployment that no practitioner using GEPA+memory would build. (4) Precheck the *break* rate on the dev split, not only the ≥4% fix rate, and pre-register the contingency if A1 breaks fall near the pilot's handful rather than the assumed 60/600. (5) Make A2-vs-A0 net accuracy at matched call budget a primary, powered endpoint, not a secondary one. (6) Add the knowledge-conflict literature to the collision check and reposition the ordering result as a replication-plus-extension.
missing_baseline: Two. The load-bearing omission is a GEPA run with memory in the loop (instructions optimized against the memory-first context, so the instruction can learn to caveat or subordinate retrieved experience). Without it, G1's anti-synergy is measured on a composition nobody deploys, and the obvious practitioner remedy is untested — it could erase the effect entirely. The cheap omission is a zero-cost framing control: memory-first, k=7, identical items, but each item wrapped as descriptive episodic evidence ('in a past episode the agent did X, outcome Y') with an instruction that retrieved experience is evidence and may be disregarded. That separates 'directive framing' from 'commitment order' at no extra compute, and it is exactly what the paper's own directiveness covariate implies should work. A6 (query-conditioned rewriting) is not a substitute — it changes item content, not imperative framing. If de-imperativized framing matches A2, the two-pass apparatus and its 2x call cost are unjustified.
preprint_collision: Above average for this exercise and clearly not a rubber stamp: it names specific recent IDs (2601.22436, 2603.00026, 2603.02473, 2607.28272, 2604.27003, 2607.13591, 2606.05684, 2603.18272), gives a per-item collide/no-collide verdict with a reason, converts two near-collisions into run conditions (A5, A6), and volunteers a genuine limitation of the mirror-image finding (2601.22436) against P6. The self-declared gap — no OpenReview/ACL-EMNLP sweep for 'ordering ablation' appendices — is honest and I share the estimate that a draft-then-consult ordering plausibly appears as an appendix ablation somewhere. The substantive failure is scope, not effort: every cluster searched is agent-memory or prompt-optimization, and none is knowledge-conflict RAG, which is where the ordering manipulation has actually been run (Xie et al. ICLR 2024; Longpre et al. 2021; the generate-then-read line). A novelty claim built on 'nobody manipulates when the agent commits' cannot stand while that literature is unsearched. I found no preprint making the P4 anti-synergy claim, and I accept that piece as currently unclaimed — which is why the paper's novelty now rests almost entirely on its least-powered and most confounded arm.
